title: 🔆🔅TEHRAN — October 13, 2026 — Rear Admiral Ali Azmaei, Commander of the IRGC Navy, made remarks on a TV talk show.
text:
🔆🔅TEHRAN — October 13, 2026 — Rear Admiral Ali Azmaei, Commander of the IRGC Navy, made remarks on a TV talk show."

"⭕️⭕️ Note: This is his first interview"

""

"SOT1: "Today, the Americans claim that the Strait of Hormuz is open, saying; "we control the Strait of Hormuz." This claim differs from the realities on the ground. Yes, they conduct their own political analysis, but if they want to see whether the Strait of Hormuz is open or closed, they should come to the field and see who controls it.""

"SOT2: "The Strait of Hormuz and the Persian Gulf are controlled by the IRGC Navy; the Gulf of Oman is under the control of our dear brothers in the Navy of the Islamic Republic of Iran Army. This means the blockade is outside the Gulf of Oman, in the Arabian Sea or even further down. One side is controlled by the Islamic Republic of Iran Army forces, our dear brothers in the Navy, while the Persian Gulf and the Strait of Hormuz are also controlled by my comrades in the IRGC Navy. Controlling what? Intelligent control. What does that mean? It means a number of vessels for which we must grant permission, with Iran as their destination and Iran as their origin, according to the hierarchy.""

"SOT3: "We will firmly and decisively deal with any enemy that wants to resort to bullying, and we are waiting for one of their warships to come so that we can sink it right here at the bottom of these Persian Gulf waters, at the entrance of the Strait of Hormuz, outside the strait, before it enters, we will sink it right there.""

"SOT4: "Today, the U.S. military in fact seven Fleets of its army have turned into a fuel smuggler. If you want to know the reality, the reality is that its $13-billion aircraft carrier has become useless, just like an airport runway that has moved 700–800 kilometers away from the Strait of Hormuz. Why? Because it is vulnerable and does not dare to get close and come within range of the combatants.""

"SOT5: "We punish any delinquent party that, with the encouragement of the Americans, decides to pass the Strait, they are persuading them, not with their vessels but with their F-35, F-16, and F-18 fighter jets, MQ-9s and MQ-1s. They have stationed them over the Strait of Hormuz so that they can smuggle four, five, or three tankers stealthily, with their lights off, out of this region, just like fuel smugglers. They hired people at great cost, and now everyone has reached the conclusion that getting oil to West Asia costs them around $150 per barrel.""

"SOT6: "We have dealt decisively with the violators as they pass by with their lights off (stealthily). The Americans have created a media silence, alongside some countries that are unfortunately cooperating with them, so that the people of the world do not realize that the violating ship is being punished. We had to release the footage of one or two of them yesterday and the day before; we had to release the footage so that they understand the humiliation and disgrace America has reached.
